d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how China and Russia have long pitched a new global financial order—one where developing economies in Africa can trade and borrow without relying on the US dollar. On paper, Beijing’s push for the Chinese yuan promises cheaper transactions and faster settlements through its CIPS payment network and new African clearing hubs. Yet in reality, de-dollarisation across Africa is stalling. From mismatched banking regulations and digital infrastructure gaps to severe debt distress across 22 African nations, the continent isn't ready—or eager—to swap…
